# huggingface Provider

Configure Hugging Face model repository and trusted-publisher management with a bootstrap credential.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    huggingface = {
      source  = "registry.terraform.io/m11s-io/huggingface"
      version = "= 0.1.0" # Target release; not yet published.
    }
  }
}
# Supply HF_TOKEN through the environment, not committed configuration.
provider "huggingface" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) API endpoint. Falls back to HF_ENDPOINT when unset, then https://huggingface.co. HTTPS is required except for loopback testing.
- `request_timeout_seconds` (Number) Positive request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bootstrap access token. Falls back to HF_TOKEN only when unset. A legacy Write personal access token is proven for owning-account CRUD.
